items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: "I think Evan Thomas was in that band at one time." ... "I had never heard him." ... "I never remembered Evan Thomas or any of those other bands coming into Baton Rouge."

ctx.x: How far was Daumersonville(?) from Baton Rouge?

Daumersonville(?) was across the river, going to new Orleans, maybe twenty miles from Baton Rouge. And Crackamon(?), Louisiana, was another town, maybe ten miles from Daumersonville(?), that had a good band called The Blue Devils. I think Evan Thomas was in that band at one time.
I was going to ask you about Evan Thomas, The Black Eagle Band.
